title: Hazel and the Contact
author: Casper Ravensworth
blurb: Marguerite Pemberton, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
